title: 跨節點累計、Shadow/Enforce 模式切換、月初重置與臨時覆寫 (Cross-Node Fair-Use, Shadow/Enforce, Monthly Reset & Temporary Override)
expected: Fair-Use policy enforces tier invariants, aggregates member usage across multiple serving exits (node & node2), transitions from shadow to enforce mode and across usage thresholds by recompiling only carrying exits, installing Tier 2 kernel tc classes on both exits, and clearing fair_use.applying from true to false once both carrying exits acknowledge the compiled generation, while ignoring duplicate/replayed events and preserving per-incarnation retained usage across node re-enrollment.
actual: Live multi-node test enrolled second exit 01a1902c-df9f-7494-bfd3-5c4f56f6f07e (node2) and non-carrying node 01a1902e-3aa3-7393-8619-91be8b750813, routed memberA traffic across both carrying exits (aggregating 28459 bytes across 2 exits), verified shadow mode (60Mbit on node, 15Mbit on node2), proved Transition 1 (policy.activated mode=enforce: carrying gens node 8->10, node2 4->5, non-carrying 0->0; Tier 2 5Mbit/2Mbit tc classes on both exits; fair_use.applying true->false in 7032 ms via observation 01a1902e-934f-7e82-a9fd-0a3bc7dd6693; replay no double bump) and Transition 2 (fup.member_generation_changed via usage threshold crossing: carrying gens node 11->12, node2 6->7, non-carrying 0->0; Tier 2 5Mbit/2Mbit tc classes on both exits; fair_use.applying true->false in 29864 ms via observation 01a1902f-8382-7102-898d-c247a2cb5b37; replay no double bump), and verified ENR-03 per-incarnation retained usage across node2 re-enrollment (01a1902c-e118-7aea-a535-b182bd653cb9 -> 01a1902f-c18b-7863-b1e9-4e63bbad5a9e).

mechanism_checks.summary: Shadow mode records would_apply_tier_index=1 with generation=0 and unthrottled node rates; switching to enforce mode increments generation=1 and applies Tier 1.
